cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.

mechanism: A makes a trained worker dismissal conditional on another supervised check, extending its claimed teaching authority beyond closing.
confusable: Not simply asking for company: permission to depart remains A to grant.
comparison: Employer-like closing lesson versus social acquaintance claiming authority over goodbye.
seedUse: D50 shop/till/daughter/taxi; S05 assess closing competency to withhold dismissal.
